sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 44638 of 2023
Applicant :- Rajesh Sahu @ Raju Sahu

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vineet Kumar Sahu Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Case No. 1484 of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No. 376 of 2018, under Section 419,
420, 272, 273 I.P.C, P.S. Muttiganj, District Prayagraj pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Allahabad together with impugned charge-sheet dated 08.12.2019 and impugned cognizance order dated 14.09.2023 passed by the learned Magistrate.
It is further prayed to stay the further proceeding of the aforesaid case.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is not named in the F.I.R.
The name of the applicant came into light in the confessional statement of co-accused Rohit Kesarwani.

It is further submitted that on the basis of statement of said co-accused, F.I.R. has been lodged Rajesh Sahu @ Raju Sahu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199432557/
1 against the applicant and charge sheet has been submitted.

entities.text: Rajesh Sahu @ Raju Sahu vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has been granted protection by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 4.4.2019 in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 8403 of 2019.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 8403 of 2019
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is submitted that there is no evidence of involvement of applicant in the crime.

Per contra learned Additional Government Advocate opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicant and submitted that the cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record, the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.

However, it is provided that in case the applicant applies for bail within a period of 30 days from today, his application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days or till the applicant surrenders and applies for bail,no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
With the above observations, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C, is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 17.1.2024 SY  Rajesh Sahu @ Raju Sahu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199432557/
